card.text: GJ 3470 b was found in 2012 by La Silla Observatory as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 3470 b"
sources.quote: GJ 3470 b is an exoplanet orbiting the star GJ 3470, located in the constellation Cancer.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around GJ 3470. Its orbit and size follow Awiphan et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 3470 b"
sources.quote: With a mass of just under 14 Earth-masses, a radius approximately 4.3 times that of Earth's, and a high equilibrium temperature of 673 K, it is a hot Neptune.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
